tbesh_html:
1) to extend, spread, trip, take quick little steps
1a) (Piel)
1a1) to spread out
1a2) to carry on the palms, dandle
1a3) to rear children

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to flatten out or extend (as a tent); figuratively, to nurse achild (as promotive of growth);
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; or perhaps a denominative from H2947 (טֵפַח), from dandling on the palms
